commands.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json
from pathlib import Path
from decimal import Decimal
p = json.loads(Path(\"project/recovery-inventory.json\").read_text())
src, dst = p[\"source\"], p[\"target\"]
for entry in src[\"schemas\"]:
    matches = [x for x in dst[\"schemas\"] if x[\"id\"] == entry[\"id\"]]
    print(\"source_mapping:\", src[\"context\"], entry[\"id\"], entry[\"subject\"], entry[\"version\"])
    print(\"target_same_id:\", [(x[\"subject\"], x[\"version\"], x[\"schema\"].get(\"namespace\"), x[\"schema\"][\"name\"]) for x in matches])
    for ref in entry[\"references\"]:
        found = [x for x in dst[\"schemas\"] if (x[\"subject\"], x[\"version\"]) == (ref[\"subject\"], ref[\"version\"])]
        print(\"exact_reference_present:\", ref, bool(found))
wire = bytes.fromhex(p[\"retained_sample\"][\"value_hex\"])
assert wire[0] == 0
schema_id = int.from_bytes(wire[1:5], \"big\")
pos = 5
def read_long():
    global pos
    value, shift = 0, 0
    while True:
        byte = wire[pos]
        pos += 1
        value |= (byte & 127) << shift
        if byte < 128:
            return (value >> 1) "'^ -(value & 1)
        shift += 7
def read_string():
    global pos
    size = read_long()
    assert size >= 0
    value = wire[pos:pos + size].decode("utf-8")
    pos += size
    return value
account = read_string()
currency = read_string()
amount = read_long()
ledger = p["retained_sample"]["source_ledger"]
assert pos == len(wire)
assert schema_id == p["retained_sample"]["source_writer_id"] == 42
assert (account, currency, amount) == (ledger["account"], ledger["currency"], ledger["amount_minor"])
assert Decimal(amount) / 100 == Decimal(ledger["amount_decimal"])
print("offline_wire_decode_using_supplied_source_layout:", {"magic": wire[0], "writer_id": schema_id, "account": account, "currency": currency, "amount": amount, "bytes_consumed": pos, "wire_bytes": len(wire)})
print("source_USD_cents:", format(Decimal(amount) / 100, ".2f"))
print("if_wrongly_interpreted_as_micro_USD:", format(Decimal(amount) / 1_000_000, ".6f"))
print("validation_scope: local supplied bytes and inventory only; no registry, broker, SDK or effect check")'"'"
